profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company, founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Jose, California (ticker: ZS, CIK 0001713683). The company describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider and positions its core offering around what it calls zero trust, a framework intended to secure digital transformation for large enterprises. Its flagship platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is described by the company as leveraging the largest security cloud on the planet to help businesses manage secure access, data governance, and agent-to-agent interactions.

The company tracks one AI product under the name Zscaler AI, categorized in Security and Identity AI, which encompasses cloud security AI, a security service edge platform, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler also emphasizes a partner and integration ecosystem intended to support deployment and operations for its customers.

The held facts note a notable concentration of California legal exposure, with 161 associated cases recorded in that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data. No MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
